Replied in #coastal-team for you, Bettina.

The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was November 3, 2025. Moss's 11/2 digest and your December 2025 cutover recap both give that date. Your recap also says you kept running PHL day to day until November 21, and that Kwame fully took over on November 22. For the tracker, use November 3 as the official date. If it needs a single "took over" date, confirm November 22 with Kwame or Moss.
